items.name: Door County Cube Challenge 2025
items.information: Welcome to Door County's fourth WCA Competition! We hope to see you here this May! If you have never competed before, this is a great first competition to attend. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [**WCA Regulations**](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [**WCA Competition Tutorial**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook groups: [**Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473) and [**Minnesota Cubing Community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6239c56608b03fda2194e41dd545ce91819975d/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

items.name: German Open 2025
items.information: In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2025 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun! Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2025 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.name: Peristeri Spring Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxNDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3bff12c8b9b6016985d4932977574e412605ceb3/486747483_24056017737321961_6930283358538797018_n.jpg) Το Peristeri Spring Open 2025 θα είναι o τρίτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στον Δήμο Περιστερίου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. items.information: **Қазақша** QBERS League In Astana 2025 – Астанадағы ашық жарыс. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 5000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. **Русский** QBERS League In Astana 2025 - это открытые соревнования в Астане. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 5000. Главная событие сорвенований - QBERS League. QBERS League - это неоффицальный ивент, который будет проводиться в формате турнирной сетки. Подробнее про QBERS League смотрите во вкладках. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. **English** QBERS League In Astana 2025 is an open competition in Astana. The base registration fee for any number of events is 5000 tenge. The main event of the competition is QBERS League. QBERS League is an unofficial event that will be held in the format of a tournament grid. For more information about QBERS League, see the tabs. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Bozeman for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2025
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.
